subtitle: Lesson 4 · Real fields, out of real JSON

eyebrow: Colon to reach in, double-colon to cast
code:
raw_payload:ticket_id             -- still VARIANT
raw_payload:ticket_id::STRING     -- a real STRING
raw_payload:refund_amount::NUMBER(10,2)
caption: Skipping the cast is a common mistake — it quietly breaks SUM() and ORDER BY later.

code:
SELECT
  raw_payload:ticket_id::STRING AS ticket_id,
  raw_payload:status::STRING AS status,
  raw_payload:opened_at::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS opened_at,
  raw_payload:refund_amount::NUMBER(10,2) AS refund_amount
FROM raw.tickets_api_raw;
caption: The exact field list Lesson 6's MERGE statement reuses, proven here first.
